title: Glossary
summary: Short explanations of the words used in the app.

blocks.caption: Glossary
rows: Administrator
The family member who manages members, permissions and settings.
Preset
A ready-made set of permissions, such as Parent, Child, Grandparent or Guest.
Module
A part of the app: Tasks, Wishlist, Finance or Health.
Authenticator app
A phone app that shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.
Two-step verification
Signing in with your password and a second proof, such as a code or a passkey.
Passkey
A way to sign in or confirm with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.
Recovery code
A one-time emergency code for when you lose your phone.
Co-buy
Several people buying one gift together.
Transaction
One entry of money coming in, going out or moving between accounts.
Recurring expense
A bill that repeats, such as rent.
CSV file
A simple table file that most banks let you download.
Archive
Hiding a health record without deleting it, so it can be restored.
Unverified
A detail suggested by AI that no person has checked yet.
Push notification
A short alert on your device.
PWA (installed app)
The website installed on your device so that it opens like an app.
